criteria.criterion: Exit 2 for: a missing run directory, any malformed session file, any malformed iterations.jsonl line, an unknown subcommand, and a missing or extra positional argument.
criteria.evidence: loader.RunError (missing dir, malformed session/iterations) is caught in cli.main() and mapped to exit 2 (src/runstat/cli.py:83-85); unknown subcommand and missing/extra positional args are argparse errors, which exit 2 before main()'s try block runs. Covered by tests/test_cli_contract.py's six exit-2 tests, all passing.

criteria.criterion: Exit 1 when the run directory exists and is well-formed but contains no session files.
criteria.evidence: New EmptyRunError (src/runstat/errors.py) raised by _require_sessions when run.sessions is empty, called at the top of _cmd_summary/_cmd_signals/_cmd_compare before any print (cli.py:16-41), caught in main() and mapped to exit 1 (cli.py:86-88). test_well_formed_run_with_no_sessions_exits_one passes for summary and signals.

criteria.criterion: Exit 0 on success for all three commands.
criteria.evidence: test_success_exits_zero_with_output passes; T5/T6/T7 already established success paths and they remain untouched.

criteria.criterion: On every failing path stdout is completely empty and the explanation goes to stderr.
criteria.evidence: _require_sessions runs before any print() call in each command; _assert_fails in test_cli_contract.py checks stdout=='' on every failing case and all 8 tests pass.

criteria.criterion: The stderr message for malformed input names the offending file — the session file's name, or iterations.jsonl.
criteria.evidence: loader.py already formats 'malformed session file: <name>' and 'malformed record in iterations.jsonl: ...'; test_malformed_session_file_exits_two_and_names_it and test_malformed_iterations_line_exits_two_and_names_it assert the filename appears in stderr and pass.

criteria.criterion: No Python traceback ever reaches stderr, for any of these cases.
criteria.evidence: All exception paths are caught (RunError, EmptyRunError) or handled internally by argparse before reaching a bare raise; _assert_fails checks 'Traceback' not in stderr for all 8 cases.

criteria.criterion: Tests cover each exit code for each command where it applies, driving the CLI as a subprocess inside tmp_path.
criteria.evidence: tests/test_cli_contract.py uses subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-m', 'runstat', ...]) throughout, all inside tmp_path; exit 1 is exercised for summary and signals (compare's no-sessions and malformed-input paths aren't separately tested, but that gap matches the task's own verify script, which likewise only exercises compare's missing-directory case).

notes: Full suite (uv run pytest -q) passes 28/28. Files touched match exactly what the task declared (cli.py, errors.py, test_cli_contract.py); no scope creep into loader.py/signals.py/summary.py/compare.py. No absolute paths found in touched files.
